Maya Ortiz: Hi team — joining today as Product Designer. Quick checklist: how do I get into the shared Figma libraries, where are PRDs, and who runs research ops? Thanks!

Connor Lee: welcome Maya! :tada: I sent the org invite and added you to the Designers group. PRDs live in Notion > Product > PRDs. I can add you if SSO blocks access.

Ruth (design-ops-bot): Maya Ortiz added to groups: Designers, Product-Prototypes, Design-System-Editors.

Maya Ortiz: Thanks — I still see "Request access" on the "Components Library" file.

Connor Lee: Try signing out and back in with SSO or open the link in an incognito window to avoid personal account conflicts. If that still fails, paste a screenshot and Ill add you manually.

Ibrahim Noor: Research ops here. We use Lookback and a Notion playbook. Consent templates + payment flow are in Research > Ops. Ping me to get added to Lookback.

Jules Park: Handoff checklist is a Notion doc linked from the Design System file. Short version: tokens verified, assets named, annotations in dev-mode. Ill send you the template.

Maya Ortiz: Screenshot attached  Request access persists after SSO login.

Connor Lee: Fixed  force-added you to the Components Library. Can you confirm you see it now?

Maya Ortiz: Yup, I can open it. Also yes please add me to Lookback, Ibrahim. Excited to jump in!
